system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I’m Sophia Silva, user ID sophia_silva_7557. I’m calling because earlier this month I had a business flight with your airline that was canceled, and because of that I missed an extremely important meeting.

This caused me serious inconvenience and professional damage, and I want compensation for the missed meeting and everything that resulted from your cancellation. I don’t think a standard apology or travel credit is enough here. This affected my work, and I expect your airline to make this right.

I’m sorry this happened.

I’ve confirmed your profile, but I can only offer compensation that is allowed under airline policy, and I need to confirm the specific reservation facts before I can do that.

What I can do here:
- review the reservation from earlier this month,
- confirm whether it included a canceled business flight,
- and if so, offer the compensation permitted by policy.

For a canceled flight reservation, the compensation I’m allowed to offer is:
- a certificate for $100 per passenger, after confirming the facts.

I’m not able to provide compensation for missed meetings, professional damage, or losses beyond that through this channel.

Please provide the reservation ID for that trip. If you don’t know it, I can help locate it from the reservations on your profile:
- NM1VX1
- KC18K6
- S61CZX
- H8Q05L
- WUNA5K

I don’t have the reservation ID in front of me, but it was earlier this month and it was absolutely canceled. You can see that on my profile.

Frankly, $100 is nowhere near acceptable. I missed an important business meeting because of your airline’s cancellation, and that cost me far more than that. I need proper compensation for the missed meeting and the disruption this caused.

Please look up whichever of those reservations was the business flight and escalate this, because I’m not accepting a token certificate for something that seriously affected my work.
